Adelheid is a Demon from the Dark World, belonging to the Hell Knights.

She is a student of Beowulf.

Personality
Honest and direct person, which believes in respectful conduct. Adelheid is good friends with Lina and views her as her rival.

She is a good-hearted and honest woman that worships Beowulf. However, she isn't afraid to speak up her mind and often contradicts her more pessimistic mentor. She's chivalrous and hard-working, like Lina has a tendency to proclaim her title in a flashy way.

Appearance
She has blond hair and blue eyes.

History
Background
Adelheid is a demon under Beowulf and a Hell Knight in training.

Like her mentor, she is able to use a demon eye, and serves under the 9 Noble Demon Families, but has not been assigned to serve under any particular Lord.

Timeline RPGX
She has worked together with Lina at times, and both have become friends and rivals after defeating the demon Azan. As their masters, Ingrid and Beowulf were old friends, they also share a friendship and rivalry to become worthy Hell Knights.

When Lina, aimed to become a Hell knight by the ancient ritual of the primordial hell knights. Adelheid introduced Lina to her mentor, Beowulf to be approved, for the true test. However, Beowulf, which had been frustrated for many years with the current system of politics, did not take the matter serious and just gave her approval casually. This made Adelheid angry, which demanded that her master took the matter serious. Both demanding, to show their skills in a dual. Beowulf, was moved by Adelheid and became impressed by Lina and gave her more honest approval afterward.

In the year 2088, Tsubaki, Matou Youko, visited the noble Ortol for information about the magician, Simon. Ortol herself, knew about him possibly being active in the small city of a local lord. Ortal at the time also had other visitors, including Beowulf and Adelheid, a calling card was given to Ortol, that the Phantom Thief, Mardel would steal her dreams. As the thief arrived, Ortol was already struggling to stay awake. Though the group was able to fight Mardel off in the end, it could take a tiny jewel of the memories of the dream. As Mardel ate the memories, she instantly collapsed, with her eyes rolling in the back of her head out of pure shock. As the entire group, is rather confused by this, Ortol stated she is never able to remember the dreams, she has while in between dimensions. Ortol afterward, stays behind as, Adelheid, (captured) Mardel, Tsubaki and Matou Youko make their way to defeat, Simon. The group arrived, using Mardel to spy into the minds of the soldiers and people, and learned the truth about Simon and the Lord. Storming the castle at night, Adelheid was able to use her demonic eye, to see the true weak point, within the hair of Simon, which made his later defeat possible. The group afterward separated but remained friends.

Adelheid had joined Beowulf into the civil war of Tokyo Kingdom and using her shield protected her from Teutates, as Beowulf confronted Teutates true core.

Powers/Abilities
Main weapon: Sword and Shield

Close Combat Skilled
Demon Eye: Can see the weak points of enemies.
Magic Dragon Shield: Guards against all attacks.
